facts.text: I'm not watching you, Parker. I'm observing. Pass the fries and keep your head down.
facts.why: Not an MJ line. Her real lines on Wikiquote include one about being obsessed with telling the truth, which is the same length and suits her.
facts.fix: I'm obsessed with telling the truth even if it hurts other people's feelings!
